name: AetherForge - Content Queue to X (via OpenTweet)

parameters.content:
## AetherForge auto-poster (simplified)

1. Import this workflow. Add 2 credentials: **GitHub Contents Token** (fine-grained PAT, Contents: Read and write, scoped to this one repo) and **OpenTweet API Key**.
2. The Fetch / Mark Posted node URLs already point at this repo (alexanderafolabi1-afk/aetherforge-content). Editing them is only needed if you forked the repo.
3. Point **Post to X via OpenTweet** at OpenTweet's real endpoint/auth scheme — the URL here is a placeholder; there's no verified public spec to hardcode against.
4. Test with **Execute workflow**, then toggle **Active**. No file exports, no Code node left for you to write — it's all wired.

The Command Deck's Connectors → GitHub Sync now commits the queue directly from the PWA. Nobody needs to touch data/content-queue.json by hand anymore — see AUTOMATION_GUIDE.md.

nodes.name: Fetch Content Queue (GitHub)
nodes.notes: Default (non-raw) Accept header — the response includes both `content` (base64) and `sha`, so this one request supplies everything the rest of the workflow needs.

nodes.name: Post to X via OpenTweet
nodes.notes: Placeholder endpoint — replace with OpenTweet's documented tweet-creation URL and auth scheme before activating. Leave "Continue On Fail" off: if a post fails here, the run stops before anything gets marked posted, so it safely retries next cycle instead of mismarking a mix of successes and failures.

nodes.name: Mark Posted (GitHub commit)
nodes.notes: sha/content/message all come straight from "Build Updated Queue" — nothing left to assemble by hand.
